design.q2_declarationAndLoading: units.json gains supplementSnapshots: [{ path: 'evidence/admission-snapshot-supplement-20260922.json', sha256: '<file sha256>' }], paths resolved against the roadmap directory like programSnapshot (validate-roadmap.mjs:310). In the ledger block taskByKey becomes a copy of actualByKey plus every supplement occurrence (same key rule and the task fields the tick and holders checks read: package, sourcePath, sourceId, sourceIdExplicit, sourceLine, text, checkedAtAdmission). Refusals: a file whose sha256 differs from the recorded one ('supplement snapshot <path> sha256 <actual> differs from the recorded <recorded>'); a group naming a package not in the admission snapshot ('supplement snapshot <path> names package <name>, which the admission snapshot does not admit'); a key already in the snapshot or an earlier supplement ('supplement snapshot <path> repeats task occurrence <key>'; the entry is not loaded).
